items.q: this fellow john marrero he played with papa still is dead

ctx.x: to caffrey d'Aerensburg were there any other guitar or banjo players you liked back in the 20s in in that
time yes yeah way back in the oldest days this fellow john marrero he played with papa still is dead yeah i knew laurence marrero i mean laurence but john was the one john was the one with uh

celestate that was his older brother that's right i never knew him i knew the younger yeah john i mean i knew laurence the younger brother we talked to his brother they still have one brother living eddie marrero he's playing bass so he's living yet the other brother simon is dead too the bass player was something and uh it has lots of banjo
